title: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor

suppliers.sup:70510: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
messages.subject: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

messages.subject: Part 350011 – 2027 terms: payment days and volume
messages.body:
Dear Ms Lechner,

Thank you for your offer for the 7.5 kW motor. We understand the copper effect behind your adjustment.

Our current contract ctr:4600070510 runs on 90 days payment. We would like to keep that term rather than move to 30 days.

Our latest forecast fc:350011@2026-09 shows a volume change of 11.9 %, to 6,110 pc a year. That gives your plant a larger, stable load.

We propose the attached packages, both without an index clause. If 366.50 needs your pricing committee's approval, could you please submit it for review? Could you also share your earliest possible lead time?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
messages.subject: Re: Part 350011 – 2027 terms: payment days and volume
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.

Our offer stands at a price of €373.57 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. To accommodate your request for longer payment terms, we propose a compromise of 60 days net at €371.50 per unit, with a price of €371.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, no Preisgleitklausel.

Our colleagues will address your inquiry regarding the earliest possible lead time. This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Logistics: As part of our standard procedures, please be advised that our Lieferzeit is 35 days.
